why: Measures the 'comfortable corridor' rung with the MINIMUM corridor's body, collapsing two of the gap taxonomy's three rungs onto each other. Issue #822's budget is stated against the 3-cell rung specifically, so a silent collapse would report 0.94 where the board scores 0.72 and every shipped board would clear a 60% bar it does not actually meet. Worth its own entry because the first draft of the nesting assertion used `toBeLessThanOrEqual`, under which this mutation SURVIVED -- equal satisfies it. The test now asserts strict ordering, which every shipped board separates by a wide margin (arena-01: 0.945 / 0.718 / 0.522).
